blurb.text: A Right Bank Bordeaux appellation. Bordeaux's rules allow Sauvignon, Sémillon and Muscadelle for white and Merlot, the Cabernets, Cot, Carmenère and Petit Verdot for red.

sources.name: WSET Level 4 Diploma in Wines, Specification, Issue 1 (2019), the principal regions of Units D3, D4 and D5
